payload.title: Plotting as a GeoSeries Dashboard
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook demonstrates how to explore and visualize a subset of LiPD datasets using Pyleoclim. It focuses on creating GeoSeries objects and plotting them as dashboards. The notebook loads GeoSeries data from a file, interpolates the data for faster processing, and generates visualizations using Pyleoclim's dashboard functionality.

section_blurbs.blurb: The notebook introduces the process of exploring LiPD datasets and creating GeoSeries objects using Pyleoclim. It includes loading data from a file, interpolating it for efficiency, and generating a dashboard plot.
section_blurbs.heading: Plotting as a GeoSeries Dashboard
